image_description: A museum exhibit featuring a complete Triceratops skeleton mounted on a raised platform. The skeleton is displayed in a large hall with classical architecture, including columns and decorative elements. The skeleton shows the characteristic three horns, large frill, and quadrupedal stance. The bones are dark brown/black in color, mounted on a light-colored platform with barriers around it.
